property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the JPEGExportPreference (a Application).

property.name: exportingSpread
property.shortdesc: If true, exports each spread as a single JPEG file. If false, exports facing pages as separate files and appends sequential numbers to each file name.

property.name: pageString
property.shortdesc: The page(s) to export, specified as a page number or an array of page numbers. Note: Valid when JPEG export range is not all.

property.name: embedColorProfile
property.shortdesc: True to embed the color profile, false otherwise.

property.name: jpegColorSpace
property.shortdesc: One of RGB, CMYK or Gray

property.name: useDocumentBleeds
property.shortdesc: If true, uses the document's bleed settings in the exported JPEG.

property.name: antiAlias
property.shortdesc: If true, use anti-aliasing for text and vectors during export.

property.name: simulateOverprint
property.shortdesc: If true, simulates the effects of overprinting spot and process colors in the same way they would occur when printing.

property.name: exportResolution
property.shortdesc: The export resolution expressed as a real number instead of an integer. (Range: 1.0 to 2400.0)

property.name: jpegSuffix
property.shortdesc: Suffix to be used at the end of each exported file.

property.name: exportingHiddenSpread
property.shortdesc: If true, export hidden spreads. If false, skip export of hidden spreads.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the JPEGExportPreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
